about: DCInside projectcc posts on the Dimensional Rift (차원의 이면) at the 15% bracket, 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-03, captured in evidence/r2026-10-03/02-dc/dc. Shape of evidence/08-extract/BRIEF.md; each clear also carries the fields of the rift-clears shape in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-rift-15-clears-design.md (rift_attempt). Brackets are computed from curated/rift-levels.json (season 1 levels) against the team power the in-Rift header shows (the sword figure under the player name), which includes 차원의 힘; power_basis 'rift' means that figure. Cookies are read from portraits in the battle bar against crumblehub's portraits; '?' where a portrait could not be matched. 'suggested_standing' is this lane's suggestion, for the curator to decide.

posts.title_en: (Info) Dimensional Rift info and power cuts
posts.summary_en: An info post: you need about 4G (328-30's 35% cut) to reach the Rift; inside, 차원의 힘 accrues at n per minute where n is the Rift level, and levelling it raises power; the structure is to raise power while idle, match each boss's 35% cut, and push. 'Some bosses fall at the 15% cut too: I took level 3, the Werehound Princess, at 15%.' Screenshots: 차원의 힘 Lv.4 (1,850/2,040) at 'level 4 repeating'; the Lv.4 effects (Rift ATK, DEF and HP amplification +30%, crit damage +90%, crit rate +30%, focus +15%, accuracy +20%); a table of the cuts per level (100%, 15% at 20%, 35% at 40%, 55% at 60%) for levels 1-25, which matches curated/rift-levels.json. Comments: the Rift's power is its own, from 차원의 힘; for 15% 'shred well' and stack Dark Choco to 10 with skill 2.

clears.note: Text claim by the author.

builds.why: A commenter: at 15%, stack Dark Choco to 10 with skill 2.

mechanics: The bracket cuts in the Rift are percentages of each level's recommended power: 15% at 20%, 35% at 40%, 55% at 60% (table image 78283-3, same figures as rift-levels.json).
rift: 차원의 힘 accrues at n per minute, n the Rift level (text).
차원의 힘 Lv.4 effects (screenshot 78283-2): Rift ATK, DEF and HP amplification 30%, crit damage +90%, crit rate +30%, focus +15%, accuracy +20%.
Entry needs about 4G, 328-30's 35% cut.

quotes.kr: 방치 보상으로 투력을 높여서 투력 컷을 35%에 맞춰서 보스를 하나씩 밀면서 방치 보상을 높이는 구조임. 특정 보스들은 15% 컷에도 잡힘. 나는 3단계 망치 15%로 잡음.
quotes.en: The structure: raise power with idle rewards, match the 35% cut, push one boss at a time and raise the idle rewards. Some bosses fall at the 15% cut too. I took level 3, the Werehound Princess, at 15%.

quotes.kr: 방깎 잘들어가는 세계선 찾는게 이면 핵심인듯. 계속 리트 ㄱㄱ
quotes.en: Finding the run where the DEF shred lands is the heart of the Rift. Keep retrying.

glossary.en: Twisting (온몸 비틀기, 'body-twisting'): forcing a clear below the comfortable bracket by retries, level adjustment and lineup swaps, as in '이면 15% 비틀기'
'World line': the lucky run in which the RNG (DEF shred landing, pathing) lines up for a clear
Rift power: the team power the Rift shows, inflated by 차원의 힘
'On the Rift's basis': a power figure stated as the Rift shows it
